questions.name: Arithmetic
questions.explanation: `7 / 2` is integer division, so it's `3`, and `3 * 2` is `6`: `7 - 6` prints `1`. Picking `0` means doing the math as if `7 / 2` were `3.5`.

questions.name: Lists and generics
questions.prompt: Which of these lines compile? Assume `java.util.*` is imported.
questions.explanation: Generics take class names, so `string` isn't a type (it's `String`). An `ArrayList` is a `List`, so `b` compiles, but it's never a `String[]`.

questions.name: Search running time
questions.prompt: What is the worst-case time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of `n` items? Use Big-O notation.
questions.explanation: Each step halves the part of the array still in play, so it takes about log₂ n steps to get down to one item.

questions.name: countVowels
questions.prompt: Write `countVowels(s)`, which returns how many vowels (`a e i o u`, upper or lower case) are in `s`.
questions.explanation: Loop over the characters and count the ones in `"aeiouAEIOU"`. Lowercasing each character first handles capitals with a single check.

questions.name: BankAccount class
questions.prompt:
Write the complete `BankAccount` class.

- A constructor that takes the owner's name and a starting balance
- `deposit(amount)` adds to the balance
- `withdraw(amount)` takes money out and returns `true`, or refuses and returns `false` if it would overdraw the account
- `getBalance()` returns the balance
questions.explanation: Keep the fields `private` and change the balance only through `deposit` and `withdraw`, so the class itself refuses a withdrawal that would go below 0.
